vocab.simpleZh: 有害的，会造成负面影响。
vocab.exampleEn: Excessive screen time can be detrimental to children's concentration.
vocab.exampleZh: 过多屏幕时间可能不利于孩子的专注力。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use detrimental to instead of bad for in formal writing.
vocab.upgradeZh: 正式写作用 detrimental to 比 bad for 更高分。

cycle.summaryEn: Do listening and reading like the real test, then check the mistakes right away.
cycle.summaryZh: 像正式考试一样做听力和阅读，然后立刻订正。

frame.useEn: Use to give a clear opinion.

meaningEn: This writing word helps Becky build stronger IELTS paragraphs and ideas.
meaningZh: 这个写作词可以帮助 Becky 写出更强的雅思段落和观点。
promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "detrimental" using I strongly believe that...
promptZh: 中文母语者练法：先看中文意思，跟读例句两遍，再用 "detrimental" 和 我强烈认为... 写一句 Becky 自己的话。
sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
sourceZh: 这个高分词会每天自动为 Becky 刷新，并配中文母语者适用的输出练习。
